citation: Editorial Expression of Concern: WWOX gene restoration prevents lung cancer growth in vitro and in vivo. Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2017;114(16):E3365. Inder M. Verma, Editor-in-Chief. DOI 10.1073/pnas.1704296114

rights.why: Europe PMC reports isOpenAccess N for this record. The crops reproduce printed sentences, so the images are gitignored and not published with this repository. This file is the recipe that regenerates them byte-identically from a copy of the PDF the reader already holds.

why_this_article_is_adjudicated: The text layer of this one-page PDF carries a C0 control at offset 1308, at the point where the printed page reads 'beta-actin' - the very term the notice is about. _refuse_suspect_surface refuses it, and no structured surface exists: fullTextXML returns 404 and efetch db=pmc returns front matter only with the publisher's own notice that XML download is not allowed.
needles: The crop is built over the whole sentence so the drawn glyphs can be read in context; the NEEDLE is a single-line fragment chosen because search_for returns exactly one span for it.

adjudicates.needle: does not affect their scientific conclusions
